title: White House accuses Moonshot of distilling Anthropic's model and evading chip curbs
summary: OSTP Director Michael Kratsios alleged Moonshot AI distilled Anthropic's Fable to build Kimi K3 and accessed Nvidia GB300s via Thailand; Moonshot did not concede.
reason: Escalates US-China AI rivalry rhetoric; accusation only.

title: AMD to invest up to $5B in Anthropic with 2 GW of MI450 GPUs
summary: AMD committed up to $5 billion to Anthropic, which will deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 GPUs in Helios racks.
reason: Giant compute deal for a frontier lab.

title: OpenAI announces 3.2 GW 'Project Camellia' data center in Georgia
summary: OpenAI unveiled a 1,400-acre, 3.2-gigawatt campus in Effingham County, Georgia, with power phased in 2028-2032 and reported spending of $20-30 billion.

title: Mistral signs multibillion-dollar Azure deal to expand European AI infrastructure
summary: France's Mistral AI and Microsoft agreed a deal bringing Mistral models to Azure and expanding compute in Europe; Mistral targets 1 GW by 2030.
reason: Strengthens a European alternative to US frontier labs.

title: Monday.com cuts about 20% of staff, tying restructuring to AI strategy
summary: Israel-based Monday.com cut roughly 600 jobs (about 350 in Israel) under an 'AI-driven growth strategy'.
reason: Company cites AI in sizeable layoffs.
